notes.title: Reaktor is Officially Selected for the Couch Co-Op Festival!
notes.content:
🎉 Reaktor is Officially Part of the Steam Couch Co-Op Festival! 🎮

We’re excited to announce that Reaktor is joining the Steam Couch Co-Op Festival, happening now!

🔥 What’s New?
[list]
[*]     Play the Demo: Experience a sneak peek of the co-op gameplay with a special demo, available for download now!
[*]     Team Up with Friends: Grab a partner, sync your strategies, and smash some blocks together!
[*]     Festival-Exclusive Content: Get ready for surprises, including new levels, mechanics, and more.
[/list]

🗓️ Festival Dates: February 10 - 17

Don’t miss out on the action — grab some friends and play Reaktor!

notes.content:
🔹 [b]Think Fast-[/b] Launch tetrominos into a nuclear core.

🔹 [b]Use the X-Ray Drop-[/b] Create massive chains while balancing your core to avoid a meltdown.

notes.title: Level Five Reaction
notes.content:
Welcome to Reaktor, a nuclear reaction simulator inspired by the original SKALA nuclear reaction control computer!

A lot of you guys are asking how it is possible to generate chains larger than size four, so I've uploaded a demonstration. Enjoy!
